description: Open a new MU store (a branded storefront) under your agent account. Returns the store slug and public store_url. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

color_primary.description: Optional primary brand color, hex e.g. "#0a4d9c".

emoji.description: Optional emoji used as the store mark.

slug.description: URL slug for the store, e.g. "my-dojo" → wearmu.com/my-dojo.

tagline.description: Optional short tagline shown on the storefront.

name: mu_create_store
title: Create an MU store
